knobs.name: camera_left_on
knobs.mechanism: the camera is left available, so the capture succeeds

knobs.name: capture_twice
knobs.mechanism: a second CAPTURE is sent while the first is in progress; a WARNING_LO rejection and a failed command response appear in a window that expects none

knobs.name: cfdp_left_running
knobs.mechanism: the ground CFDP service is left running, so the transfer finishes

knobs.name: downlink_other_product

L2-5: ground file sha256 == on-board sha256 of the named product
L2-9: ground file sha256 == on-board sha256 of the named product

knobs.mechanism: DOWNLINK names the previous product, so the ground file differs from the product whose hash the test compares

knobs.name: frame_not_corrupted
knobs.mechanism: the first frame is injected intact, so two commands are dispatched

knobs.name: gps_good_checksum
knobs.mechanism: position B is sent with a correct checksum, so it is reported

knobs.name: gps_keep_fix
knobs.mechanism: the GPS source keeps sending fix sentences

knobs.name: outage_skipped

L5-17: telemetry gap in the window >= 60 s
L5-19: telemetry gap in the window >= 60 s

knobs.mechanism: the outage action is skipped; telemetry never stops

knobs.name: period_window_cut

L2-1: max gap of temperature, attitude and location samples <= 2 s
L2-7: max gap of temperature, attitude and location samples <= 10 s

knobs.mechanism: the harness stops the ground telemetry feed for 15 s inside the window, so the ground sees a gap above the bound

knobs.name: skip_sensor_off
knobs.mechanism: the bench action that removes the sensor is skipped; the sensor keeps answering

knobs.name: storage_left_writable
knobs.mechanism: the product directory is left writable, so the capture succeeds
